metadata.title: Cinematic Duo Portrait with Geometric Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white double portrait featuring one subject positioned behind and slightly above the other, integrated with a minimalist geometric color block and clean sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of two faces with overlapping silhouettes
Contrast between organic photographic textures and sharp geometric text elements
Balance between deep shadows on the left and bright highlights on the right
Interaction between horizontal and vertical text alignments
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome palette for the image
Single muted accent color for the primary text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the central and left portions of the frame; the rear subject is larger and slightly out of focus, while the foreground subject is sharper and positioned lower.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright face of the foreground subject acts as the primary focal point, balanced by the lavender text box in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the foreground face up to the background face, then to the horizontal lavender box, and finally down the vertical text on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows on the left side provide a heavy visual weight and negative space for the subjects to emerge from.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks for shadow depth and bright whites for facial highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted lavender/dusty purple for the primary text background box.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall; the only color is a desaturated pastel, emphasizing the starkness of the monochrome image.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients in the color block

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric proportions

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a solid color rectangle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different orientations and colors to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and clean lines.
Provides a similar mid-century modern aesthetic with clean capitals.
Modern geometric feel that handles wide tracking well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of two people. One person is in the foreground looking slightly right, the other is behind them looking left. Use dramatic side-lighting to create deep shadows on one side of their faces. Apply a heavy film grain effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal muted lavender rectangle in the top right corner. Inside it, place centered black geometric sans-serif text with wide tracking. Along the far right edge, place white geometric sans-serif text rotated 90 degrees clockwise with extra-wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the lavender box a flat, solid color?
Is the vertical text rotated correctly along the right margin?
Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy and modern?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the accent color block
Degree of tracking in the typography
Contrast level of the monochrome image
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly legible against the background.
Check that the lavender box does not have a border.
Verify the grain does not obscure the facial expressions.
Confirm the vertical text is aligned to the right edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photography + Geometric color block + Wide-tracked Sans-Serif = Retro-Modern Editorial Style
